name: cm-workspace
description: Change-management working tools. An RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and evaluation criteria, writes it from a curated knowledge bank, and audits it for requirement coverage and content provenance; and a specification-to-training-deck generator that ingests an FSD, places its screenshots, draws diagrams from its prose, writes knowledge checks, and audits the result for objective coverage, provenance and screenshot triage.
